geographic_notes.text: Togo; Savanes Region; Kara Region: Agriculture vulnerability is high nationwide and very high in Savanes; under RCP6.0, Kara also reaches very high by 2050.
Togo; Coastal zone: Communication reports retreat along 40 km of sandy coast at an average 10 m yearly, aggravated by storms and local sediment dynamics.
Togo; Coastal zone: Under RCP6.0, sea level is projected to rise 11.35 cm by 2025 and 62 cm by 2100, worsening coastal erosion and livelihood risks.
Togo; Savanes Region; Plateaux Region: NDC links prolonged drought in recent decades with recurring farmer-herder conflicts in the Savanes and Plateaux livestock areas.
Mono Basin; Oti Basin; Lake Togo: Under RCP6.0 to 2030, water stocks rise in Mono but fall in Oti and Lake Togo; NDC warns inaction may heighten water-source conflict risk.
Oti Basin; Mono Basin: NDC reports 2020-2021 Oti and Mono floods caused deaths and damaged roads, markets, health centers, homes, schools, power and telecoms.
